text:
Sam: Heads-up 12:30 a cycle courier just rolled up with a small crate for visitor 'Dr. Watanabe'. Says they'll wait 10 mins. Can front desk take it? Crate looks awkward to carry inside. :bike::package:

FrontDeskBot: Delivery registered: 'Dr. Watanabe / guest'  size: small crate. Staging suggestion: short table by north bench to avoid lobby flow. Photo attached.

Zoe: I'm on reception until 13:00, I can take it. Badge printer is spitting out faint text though 1 we can use a sticker badge and log time.

Sam: Thanks Zoe. Note the visitor form for external researchers is in the red folder (top shelf). Also ask them to keep the crate on the trolley while inside 1 building policy.

Theo: FYI parcel room is almost full. If crate has packaging that can be recycled, we should ask them to take it or I'll move it to recycling after they're done. MailRoomBot: parcel occupancy 84% (alert at 90%).

FrontDeskBot: Check-in pending. Reminder: visitors require escort past secure doors.

Zoe: Accepted crate at 12:32. Issued sticker badge: 'Dr. Watanabe / Univ. Kyoto / 12:32'. Escorting to MR-1 at 12:40. Crate placed on north bench as suggested.

Sam: Great, thanks. Theo if they want us to hold packaging briefly I'll coordinate but prefer same-day removal.

Theo: Understood. If they leave packaging after demo, I'll schedule pickup with recycling crew before EOD.

FrontDeskBot: Check-in complete. Delivery staged, visitor escorted. Badge log updated.
